description: As our nation continues to cope with the coronavirus outbreak, there’s one question I hear from my friends and neighbors across North Carolina’s 7th District more than any other: “What can I do to help those in need?” The most important thing for all of us right now is to ensure we’re following the CDC’s guidelines […]
